items.title: Pay glass repair invoice
items.quote: Der Betrag ist innerhalb von 14 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug fällig.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is Friday 2026-11-20. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event itself is not counted, so counting starts 2026-11-21. 14 days later lands on Friday 2026-12-04 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). That day is a regular business day in NW (no weekend/holiday clash), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed. Payment must reach the account by this date; allow about 1 business day for a bank transfer (§ 675s BGB), so send by 2026-12-03.

items.title: Automatic direct debit for separate contract GK-8859-772
items.quote: Der monatliche Beitrag für Ihren separaten Vertrag GK-8859-772 wird wie gewohnt am 08.12.2026 per Lastschrift von Ihrem Konto eingezogen; Sie brauchen dafür nichts zu veranlassen.
items.computation: The letter states the fixed calendar date 08.12.2026 for the recurring SEPA direct debit of a separate, unrelated monthly contract. No action is required from the recipient (the letter itself says so); listed only so the person knows funds will be withdrawn on that day.

warnings: The IBAN DE90 3705 0198 0005 5806 60 is well-formed (checksum and German bank code both valid), but that only confirms the format, not that the account truly belongs to Glaserei Beispielscheibe — verify against a previous invoice or their official contact details before paying.

The invoice casually mentions an unrelated, separate contract (GK-8859-772) and its own direct-debit date; this is informational only and not a payment obligation on this invoice — check it against your own records of that contract.
